# Milestones: [Project]

Authoritative output: `production/milestones/MILESTONE.md`, authored with
`$define-milestones`. State document maturity (draft or settled definitions),
revision, decision sources and actual vertical-slice hard-gate evidence. Saving
requirements does not establish milestone achievement. Use the selected game's
meaning of MVP, Alpha, Beta and Gold; no universal content/polish threshold applies.

## Basis and progression
[Relevant CONCEPT, GDDs/BREAKDOWN, FRAMEWORK, architecture, resources/tools,
accessibility commitments and slice findings. Missing evidence and its consequence.]

## Milestone: [MVP / Alpha / Beta / Gold]
Repeat this section for each stage. A scoped update preserves all other stages.

### Overview and goal
[What this version should enable and why. Dates, duration, capacity and optional
sprints are selected planning information; leave unknowns explicitly unset.]

### Included outcomes
| Outcome / feature | Governing source | Required completeness/polish | Related work | Decision / status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [result] | [actual requirement] | [meaning for this version] | [epic/story if present] | [selected/open] |

Identify required versus optional outcomes only when the project has selected that
distinction. Record exclusions and the impact of proposed scope changes.

### Playtest questions and success criteria
| Criterion / learning question | Setup and method | Expected observation or decision basis | Evidence / evaluator | Actual result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [specific outcome] | [feasible test or human activity] | [criterion] | [planned location/responsibility] | [pending until executed] |

Include relevant system/resource/tool integration and framework operations.
Performance, bug and stability thresholds require selected requirements, units and
methods. No coverage percentage, session count or zero-bug policy is preset.

### Dependencies, risks and reviews
[Actual prerequisites, internal/external dependencies, unresolved decisions,
mitigation, agreed responsibilities and any selected review schedule. Link risk
records instead of duplicating their editable authority.]

### Progression decision
[What evidence permits progression, what still prevents it, and who is responsible
for the decision. Missing required evidence cannot establish completion.]

## Changes and affected work
[Changes to settled expectations, their basis and affected epics/stories, QA plans,
sprints, design/framework/resource documents. Do not silently change these consumers
outside the requested scope. Retain history needed to understand replacements.]
